# Our Git workflow strategy {.unnumbered}

**Repository.** Zoé created the public repository `IEAP-Series03-RStudio` on her GitHub
account and added Alexis and Albatoul as collaborators. Her first two commits set up the
project (README, LICENSE, `.gitignore`, RStudio project, master document, references and
data). After that, nobody committed directly on `main`: it only received merges.
